# Outright Landscape Construction

> Outright Landscape Construction is a licensed C-27 landscape contractor (CSLB #1073845) based in Covina, California. We are the top-rated landscaping, hardscaping, and irrigation company serving Covina, West Covina, Glendora, San Dimas, La Verne, Azusa, Claremont, Diamond Bar, Walnut, Pomona, Pasadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Duarte, El Monte, Baldwin Park, Temple City, Rowland Heights, Charter Oak, and the greater San Gabriel Valley. Founded in 2020, the company has 250+ completed projects and a 4.9-star Google rating. Owner Edward has 15+ years of hands-on industry experience.

## Services

- [Irrigation & Sprinkler Repair](https://outrightlandscape.com/Irrigation): Professional sprinkler repair, irrigation valve service, drip irrigation installation, and same-day emergency repair. We work with Rain Bird, Hunter, Toro, Irritrol, and Orbit systems. Sprinkler installation starts at $1,000. Simple repairs start at $75.
- [Hardscaping & Paver Installation](https://outrightlandscape.com/Hardscape): Custom paver patios, driveways, walkways, retaining walls, fire pits, and outdoor living spaces. Paver installation runs $15–$30 per square foot. Proper excavation, compacted base, and polymeric sand on every project.
- [Landscaping & Turf Installation](https://outrightlandscape.com/): Premium Marathon tall fescue and hybrid Bermuda grass sod installation. Complete landscape design, yard cleanup, demolition, and site preparation.
